name: MarketAccessHtaDossierPlanner
tagline: Plan, sequence and track every HTA and payer dossier of a launch – EU JCA, national agencies, evidence gaps, decisions and time to access in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete plug-and-play market access app for pharmaceutical companies. Plan HTA and payer dossiers per product, indication and country, link national dossiers to the EU joint clinical assessment, manage evidence gaps against the PICO with mitigations, sign off with a four-eyes rule and submit, follow agency assessment and clarification questions, record recommendations, net prices and listing, and see the launch timeline and time to access per country. Works immediately in demo mode; connect a collection, Dataverse, SharePoint or the Power Pages Web API in a few clicks.
features: EU HTAR / JCA dependency with enforced submission order
Configurable agency timelines (Agency=days) for expected decisions
Evidence-gap register with severity, mitigation, owner and due dates
Decision, net price and discount capture
Launch timeline with marketing authorisation and expected access
Revenue at stake and time-to-access KPIs
Generated dossier summary for the sign-off pack
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.MarketAccessHtaDossierPlanner data-set + niray_Niray.MarketAccessHtaDossierPlannerPortal field control for Power Pages, shared src/app)
